title: Poorly constructed
text: Poorly constructed. My cross arrived in a padded envelope, right away I was put off by the fact it was in two pieces. At first I thought it was a packing issue, that it has broken in transit, however upon further inspection I realized the nails that hold it together were entirely too short. I was able to use some glue to repair it, as I really didn't want to mess with the exchange process to get a new one. There is no hanger to make this a wall cross, so be prepared to have attach one yourself. I was also highly put off that the back was not only unfinished but had a big stamp across the back from where the wood was stamped at a supplier. It has a made in America sticker on the back and I am ashamed to say this was made here in the US, the craftsmanship is so very poor. All in all I was able to repair it for use, but you can still tell there is a gap between where the two pieces join.
